```json
 "topology": "StrongARM latch + output inverters",
 "rationale": "A StrongARM latch draws no static current, so energy is about C_switched*VDD^2. The budget is ~390fJ/3.24V^2, which allows ~120 fF of switched capacitance. All devices are minimum-L (0.15) for speed. The input pair is wide enough to give Av*DV ≈ tens of mV before regeneration. Cross-coupled NMOS/PMOS gm gives a tau of ~10-15 ps. Small output inverters isolate CL from the latch. Expected delay is ~100-130 ps; four PMOS switches reset all internal nodes."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "W_in":   (4.0, 1.0, 12.0),   # input pair width [um]
    "W_tail": (3.0, 1.0, 10.0),   # clocked tail width
    "W_ln":   (1.5, 0.5, 6.0),    # latch nmos width
    "W_lp":   (2.0, 0.6, 8.0),    # latch pmos width
    "W_rst":  (0.8, 0.42, 3.0),   # reset pmos width
    "W_ivn":  (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),   # output inverter nmos
    "W_ivp":  (2.0, 0.6, 8.0),    # output inverter pmos
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = 0.15
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # clocked tail
    n.M("Mtail", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_tail"], L)
    # input pair
    n.M("M1", "dip", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], L)
    n.M("M2", "din", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], L)
    # cross-coupled latch (xp sits above vinp side -> falls when vinp > vinn)
    n.M("M3", "xp", "xn", "dip", "vss", "nfet", p["W_ln"], L)
    n.M("M4", "xn", "xp", "din", "vss", "nfet", p["W_ln"], L)
    n.M("M5", "xp", "xn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_lp"], L)
    n.M("M6", "xn", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_lp"], L)
    # reset switches (clk low = reset to VDD)
    n.M("MR1", "xp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    n.M("MR2", "xn", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    n.M("MR3", "dip", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    n.M("MR4", "din", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    # output inverters: outp = NOT(xp) -> high when vinp > vinn; both low in reset
    n.M("MIP1", "outp", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_ivp"], L)
    n.M("MIN1", "outp", "xp", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_ivn"], L)
    n.M("MIP2", "outn", "xn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_ivp"], L)
    n.M("MIN2", "outn", "xn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_ivn"], L)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    cpu = 1.5e-15  # ~gate+junction cap per um width at L=0.15
    # input pair operating point at start of evaluation (Vds ~ large)
    try:
        oin = lut.op("n", p["W_in"], L, vcm, 0.6)
        gm_in = oin["gm"]; id_in = oin["Id"]
    except Exception:
        gm_in = 1e-3 * p["W_in"] / 4; id_in = 150e-6 * p["W_in"] / 4
    try:
        oln = lut.op("n", p["W_ln"], L, 0.9, 0.6)
        olp = lut.op("p", p["W_lp"], L, 0.9, 0.6)
        gm_l = oln["gm"] + olp["gm"]
    except Exception:
        gm_l = 0.4e-3 * p["W_ln"] + 0.1e-3 * p["W_lp"]

    c_d = cpu * (p["W_in"] + p["W_ln"] + p["W_rst"])
    c_x = cpu * (p["W_ln"] + p["W_lp"] + p["W_rst"]) + 1.0e-15 * (p["W_ln"] + p["W_lp"]) \
          + 1.0e-15 * (p["W_ivn"] + p["W_ivp"])
    # integration phase: discharge drain nodes to ~Vtn
    vtn = 0.62
    t_int = 2 * c_d * vtn / max(id_in, 1e-6) + c_x * (vdd - 0.9 - vtn + 0.6) / max(id_in, 1e-6)
    av = gm_in * t_int / max(c_x, 1e-16) * 0.5
    tau = c_x / max(gm_l, 1e-6)
    t_latch = tau * math.log(max(vdd / 2 / max(av * dv, 1e-6), 1.5))
    c_out = cl + cpu * (p["W_ivn"] + p["W_ivp"])
    i_inv = 300e-6 * p["W_ivn"]
    t_inv = 0.69 * c_out * 0.9 / max(i_inv, 1e-6) * 2
    delay = t_int + t_latch + t_inv

    c_sw = 2 * c_d + 2 * c_x + c_out + cpu * p["W_tail"] \
           + cpu * (4 * p["W_rst"] + p["W_tail"])  # clk-driven gates
    energy = c_sw * vdd ** 2

    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
```
